messages:
ravi_content: Quick kickoff — we've got approval from the customer for a short field notes piece + a 1–2 sentence quote. Need final customer-signed quote release by EOD Fri and legal signoff on logo + quote usage. Can @amy_marketing take the lead on the draft for the blog + social assets?

amy_marketing: On it. Plan: draft by Wed, internal review Thurs AM. Who's the final approver in Sales for the copy?

jordan_sales: I'll coordinate with the account exec and confirm the customer embargo window. Customer has asked for sync with the co-hosted webinar on 2026-04-15 — please note embargo.

leo_legal: Heads up — we need a short marketing release addendum signed (one-paragraph rights grant). Also flagging trademark and logo usage guidelines; i'll attach a template.

ravi_content: Thanks Leo. Tentative checklist:
- customer quote (1–2 lines)
- logo (vector) + explicit usage rights
- redacted screenshots if necessary
- embargo date: 2026-04-15
- lead-routing mapping for webinar form to Events SDR queue

marco_ops: For inbound leads: map webinar landing form to /sdr/events (region: NA) and tag source=acmecorp-fieldnotes. Can we capture interest_level (pilot/eval/procurement) and opt_in_marketing?

amy_marketing: Yes. @marco_ops please add fields: interest_level (dropdown: pilot, evaluation, procurement) and opt_in_marketing (checkbox). Keep the form minimal.

publish-bot: Calendar invite created: "Field Notes: AcmeCorp" 2026-04-14 10:00 AM PT — guests: ravi_content, amy_marketing, jordan_sales, leo_legal. Link: https://calendar.redwood/invite/abc123

ravi_content: Draft customer-facing quote to propose:
"Using Redwood's dedicated pools, AcmeCorp reduced inference cost by 38% while cutting 95th p99 latency by 45%."

leo_legal: Don't send that exact phrasing yet — we need the measurement window and a data source footnote. Also avoid confusing percentiles: replace "95th p99 latency" with just "p99 latency" and include sample size.

ravi_content: Updated proposed line:
"With Redwood Dedicated, AcmeCorp reduced per-token inference costs by ~38% and saw a 45% improvement in p99 latency (10k requests sample, Jan–Mar 2026)."

jordan_sales: Sending the updated copy to the customer now. I'll request a signed release by Friday.

amy_marketing: Asset plan once we have signed release:
- 400–600 word blog post (field notes)
- 30s social clip + 3 social teasers
- Co-hosted webinar (30 min) targeted at existing customers and prospects

leo_legal: Once customer signs the release, i'll complete clearance within 24 hours. Please surface any screenshot redaction requests before I finalize.

ravi_content: Perfect. @amy_marketing can you slot the draft into #marketing-review by Wed 5pm? I'll follow up with the customer for logo files and any screenshot redaction guidance.

amy_marketing: Noted. Will ping here when the draft is up. :thumbsup:
